async def act(page):
    # Click the '« Back' link to return to the previous page
    back_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="« Back")
    await back_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('load')
    
    # Check if the comment is present on the page
    page_content = await page.content()
    if 'Thanks, this solved my problem.' in page_content:
        # Comment is present, task is complete
        return "Comment already posted successfully."
    else:
        # Comment not found, need to resubmit
        # Fill the comment textbox
        comment_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Comment *")
        await comment_textbox.fill("Thanks, this solved my problem.")
        
        # Fill the name field
        name_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Name *")
        await name_field.fill("Test User")
        
        # Fill the email field
        email_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Email *")
        await email_field.fill("test@example.com")
        
        # Fill the website field if present
        website_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Website", exact=False)
        if await website_field.count() > 0:
            await website_field.fill("")
        
        # Handle the checkbox for saving details
        save_checkbox = page.get_by_role("checkbox", name="Save my name, email, and website in this browser for the next time I comment.", exact=False)
        if await save_checkbox.count() > 0:
            if await save_checkbox.is_checked() == False:
                await save_checkbox.check()
        
        # Click the submit button
        submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Post Comment")
        await submit_button.click()
        
        # Wait for submission to process
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        
        return "Comment resubmitted successfully."
